name: Holostruction
summary:
The use of Holostruction is applicable to all construction and civil engineering projects that utilize 3D holograms. It is particularly effective in the following cases. 

By being able to visualize the actual size of the completed structure from the design stage, it is possible to notice things that could only be noticed during or after construction, such as checking the size and height of the space.
